— UPDATE —
IMAGE (.bin)
INSTALL

Pick the CM7 .bin built for this device. The device reboots on its own once the image is written — keep it powered until this page comes back.

— NETWORK FLASH —
BOOTLOADER
STATUS

Reboots into the bootloader's network flasher (UDP 55152), the ST-Link replacement. Then, from the firmware repository: scripts/netboot/netflash.py flash --cm7 CM7.bin --cm4 CM4.bin. The device comes back when the tool sends BOOT, or after 120 s without a host, and this page reconnects. Holding the two outer buttons at power-on enters the same mode when this page is unreachable.

(press Refresh)

Retained-RAM journal of the bootloader (B), CM7 (7) and CM4 (4), timestamped in seconds since each boot; it survives reboots. Read on demand only: nothing is sent while Follow is off.
